City of Encinitas
Environmental Commission Meeting
AGENDA
APRIL 9, 2026 -
05:30 PM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
1.
CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL
2.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
3.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announce administrative changes to the agenda in compliance with the Brown Act.
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Oral comments (maximum of 3 minutes) will be heard from people who submit a WHITE speaker’s slip to the commission secretary. No discussion or action may be taken by the Commission on such non-agenda items. If needed, Oral Communications / Public Comment items will be referred to City Staff either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
5.
PRESENTATION:
A.
None.
6.
APPROVAL OF MINUTES
A.
Approval of February 12, 2026 Meeting Minutes
Item 6A - Draft Meeting Minutes 2-12-2026
7.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
A.
Draft Climate Action Plan Update and Benefit Cost Analysis. Crystal Najera, Sustainability Manager and Ryan Lamkin, Sustainability Analyst
Item 7 A - Informational Item Link
8.
ACTION ITEMS
A.
April update of progress on the Fiscal Year 2024-25 to 2025-26 Work Plan and review of Commission Calendar. Crystal Najera, Sustainability Manager
1.
Review and Approve April 2026 Work Plan Update.
2.
Review Commission Calendar.
Item 8A - Agenda Report Work Plan Update
Item 8A - Attachment 1 - April 2026 Work Plan Update
Item 8A - Attachment 2 - Commission Calendar
B.
Annual Selection of Chair and Vice Chair for One Year Term. Crystal Najera, Sustainability Manager
1.
Select a Chairperson and Vice Chairperson for a one-year term.
Item 8B - Agenda Report - Selection of Chair and Vice Chair
Item 8B - Attachment 1 EMC 2.49
C.
Establishment of a commission subcommittee for the development of the Fiscal Year 2026-27 and Fiscal
Year 2027-28 Work Plan. Crystal Najera, Sustainability Manager
1.
Select a Commission Subcommittee to develop a draft FY27-FY28 Environmental Commission Workplan.
Item 8C - Agenda Report - Work Plan Subcommittee
Item 8C - Attachment 1 - EMC 2.49 Work Plan Subcommittee
Item 8C - Attachment 2 - FY 24/25 and 25/26 Work Plan
9.
COMMISSIONER INITIATED ACTION AGENDA ITEMS
A.
None.
10.
UPDATES ON ITEMS OF INTEREST TO COMMISSION/ANNOUNCEMENTS BY COMMISSION MEMBERS/STAFF
11.
FUTURE COMMISSIONER INITIATED AGENDA ITEMS Discussion of possible future commissioner-initiated agenda items, including informational items, presentations, or action items, if any.
12.
ADJOURNMENT - The next Environmental Commission meeting is scheduled for May 14, 2026.
